name: weight_int8pack_mm
description: Candidate signature (A, B, scales), positional mapping to exact native aten::_weight_int8pack_mm(Tensor self, Tensor mat2, Tensor scales) -> Tensor. A is activation [M,K], B is int8 weight [N,K] (one byte per element, not bit-packed), scales is per-output-channel [N]; return [M,N], no input mutation or alias. Existing master accuracy uses half/bfloat16 activation and an eager mathematical oracle (cast weight, matmul then scale), which can round differently from fused native execution. That oracle is accuracy-only and is not the benchmark native baseline. Benchmark calls exact native API without manual dequantization or fallback. Native schema existence does not establish backend capability.
